c4116c220_quote_default_configured.meaning: governance has configured a default no-cap limit for the quote token via setDefaultNoCapLimit(quoteToken, x)
c4116c220_quote_default_configured.evidence: LatentSwapLEX exposes `setDefaultNoCapLimit(address token, uint8)` documented as: “if defaultMintRedeemNoCap == 0, new markets will use 1 baseToken as the MintRedeemNoCap as the default” and “for markets with this quote token”. At init, the code reads `tokenNoCapLimit[marketParams.baseToken]` and assigns that to the market’s `noCapLimit`. This creates a policy confusion: governance expecting to configure the default mint/redeem cap for “markets with this quote token” by calling `setDefaultNoCapLimit(quoteToken, x)` will have no effect. Only overrides set for the baseToken address are used. As a result, markets instantiated under a given quote do not inherit the intended cap setting, potentia
